text: Which platform was GSE309890 run on, and what organism is it?

Abstract
We queried the NCBI GEO database to determine (i) the microarray or sequencing platform used and (ii) the study organism for GEO Series accession GSE309 890. Using the geo_series tool with the accession “GSE309890,” we retrieved the complete Series‐level metadata without downloading supplementary data files. The record indicates that the study employed platform GPL24659 and was conducted on Escherichia coli strain K-12 substr. MG1655. No additional literature links were present for this accession in GEO at the time of retrieval. These findings satisfy the user’s request by identifying both the platform and organism associated with the study.

I. Introduction
Background. The GEO (Gene Expression Omnibus) repository stores functional genomic data, including RNA-seq and microarray studies. Each Series (GSE) record lists the experimental design, platform(s), and organism(s) investigated.  
Literature Review. No literature was retrieved for this query.  
Knowledge Gap. The user needed to know which platform and which organism are associated with GSE309 890.  
Objective & Hypothesis. Objective: Identify the experimental platform and organism for GEO Series GSE309890. Hypothesis: GEO metadata will specify one platform accession (GPL) and the organism taxonomy line.

II. Materials and Methods
Study Design. Direct retrieval of the Series metadata from GEO via the geo_series API.  
Materials. Database queried: NCBI GEO via geo_series (functions.geo_series).  
Procedures.  
• Tool call: functions.geo_series(accession="GSE309890", list_files=false)  
• Parameters: accession = “GSE309890”; list_files set false to minimise output.  
Statistical Analysis. Not applicable; single record inspection.

III. Results
Data Presentation.  
Table 1. Key metadata fields extracted from GSE309890

| Field        | Value                                     |
|--------------|-------------------------------------------|
| Platform     | GPL24659                                  |
| Organism     | Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655 |
| Experiment   | Expression profiling by high-throughput sequencing |
| Sample count | 6                                         |

Findings. The Series GSE309890 used platform GPL24659 and investigated Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655.

IV. Discussion
Interpretation. The GEO metadata clearly reports GPL24659 as the sole platform and Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655 as the experimental organism, fulfilling the query.  
Context. GPL24659 corresponds to an Illumina sequencing platform for RNA-seq expression profiling. The organism identification aligns with the study’s focus on bacterial adaptive evolution under sertraline exposure.  
Limitations. The GEO summary does not provide platform technology details (e.g., flow-cell type) beyond the GPL identifier; supplementary files would need review for further specifics.  
Conclusion & Future Directions. GSE309890 is an Escherichia coli RNA-seq study performed on platform GPL24659. Future work could download the supplementary CSV files for expression matrices or map the GPL accession to its detailed platform annotation via GEO.

References
[1] NCBI GEO Series GSE309890 summary. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE309890  

Acknowledgments
We acknowledge NCBI GEO for providing public access to functional genomics data via its E-utilities API.
